records.issue_text: **`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:36-38` + `app/models/post.rb:128-132` — unsanitized raw HTML from RSS feeds is rendered directly to all forum viewers.** `TopicEmbed.import` is called with `i.content` straight from the feed (only `CGI.unescapeHTML` applied), stored via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: :raw_html`, and `Post#cook` for that mode returns `raw` verbatim — bypassing the normal cook/sanitization pipeline entirely. Unlike `import_remote` (which restricts tags/attributes via `Readability::Document.new(..., tags: [...], attributes: [...])`), the RSS path has no whitelist. Any attacker who can influence the configured feed (compromised feed source, MITM on `feed_polling_url`, or a malicious admin-supplied feed) can inject `<script>`, `<iframe>`, event handlers, etc., which will be served as-is (stored XSS) to every visitor of the imported topic, including within the embeddable-host's own domain via the embed iframe. Fix: run RSS-sourced `contents` through the same tag/attribute whitelist used in `import_remote` (or a dedicated HTML sanitizer) before persisting, regardless of import path.

records.issue_text: **`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:22-28` — referer-based access control is trivially bypassable.** `ensure_embeddable` relies solely on `request.referer`, which is client-supplied and can be omitted or spoofed by any direct HTTP client (browsers won't fake it via JS, but curl/proxies can). This is the only gate before enqueueing retrieval/rendering of arbitrary `embed_url` content. It's a reasonable first line of defense for the common case (blocking cross-site iframe embedding), but should not be treated as the sole security boundary — worth a comment noting this is best-effort, and consider combining with the existing `X-Frame-Options` + host-match on `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` (which is solid) as the real enforcement point rather than relying on referer for authorization decisions beyond UI framing.
records.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, access is granted/denied based solely on `request.referer` host equality with `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (and can be bypassed by clients that can set/spoof the Referer header).
